period.heading: Period of Revelation
period.text: Its subject matter bears full evidence that it was revealed in the earliest period at Makkah.

theme.heading: Theme and Subject Matter
theme.text: Its theme is to affirm the Resurrection and Hereafter and to warn the people of the consequences which will ultimately follow the denial and the affirmation of these truths.
